title: Passage to the limit ε ↓ 0 in the smoothed identities (parent Steps 5–6 and Step 1 integrability)
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, E = ℝ^{n+ℓ}, μ a Borel measure on E finite on compact sets, u, q, G: E → ℝ, ξ ∈ E and σ, ρ, R, A ∈ ℝ with 0 < σ ≤ ρ < R; u and q a.e. strongly measurable for μ restricted to B_R(ξ); |u(x)| ≤ A and |q(x)| ≤ 1 for x ∈ B_R(ξ); G μ-integrable on B_R(ξ). Assume that for every ε > 0 with (1 + ε)ρ < R and every φ: ℝ → ℝ of class C¹, nonincreasing, with φ(t) = 1 for t ≤ 1 and φ(t) = 0 for t ≥ 1 + ε, (S_φ): (∫uφ(r/ρ)dμ)/ρⁿ − (∫uφ(r/σ)dμ)/σⁿ = ∫u·q·k_φ(r)dμ + ∫_{(σ,ρ]}(∫φ(r/τ)G dμ)/τⁿ⁺¹dτ, where k_φ(s) := ∫_{(σ,ρ]} −(s/τ²)φ'(s/τ)/τⁿ dτ and r = |x − ξ|. Then: (i) τ ↦ (∫_{B_τ(ξ)}G dμ)/τⁿ⁺¹ is integrable on (σ, ρ]; (ii) x ↦ u(x)·(q(x)/|x − ξ|ⁿ) is μ-integrable on B_ρ(ξ) ∖ B_σ(ξ); (iii) (∫_{B_ρ(ξ)}u dμ)/ρⁿ − (∫_{B_σ(ξ)}u dμ)/σⁿ = ∫_{B_ρ(ξ)∖B_σ(ξ)} u·(q/|x − ξ|ⁿ)dμ + ∫_{(σ,ρ]}(∫_{B_τ(ξ)}G dμ)/τⁿ⁺¹dτ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (u q G : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (σ ρ R A : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → ρ < R → AEStronglyMeasurable u (μ.restrict (closedBall ξ R)) → AEStronglyMeasurable q (μ.restrict (closedBall ξ R)) → (∀ x ∈ closedBall ξ R, |u x| ≤ A ∧ |q x| ≤ 1) → IntegrableOn G (closedBall ξ R) μ → (∀ (ε : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ε → (1 + ε) * ρ < R → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → Antitone φ → (∀ t, t ≤ 1 → φ t = 1) → (∀ t, 1 + ε ≤ t → φ t = 0) → (∫ x, u x * φ (‖x - ξ‖ / ρ) ∂μ) / ρ ^ n - (∫ x, u x * φ (‖x - ξ‖ / σ) ∂μ) / σ ^ n = ∫ x, u x * q x * (∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, -(‖x - ξ‖ / τ ^ 2) * deriv φ (‖x - ξ‖ / τ) / τ ^ n) ∂μ + ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, (∫ x, φ (‖x - ξ‖ / τ) * G x ∂μ) / τ ^ (n + 1)) → IntegrableOn (fun τ ↦ (∫ x in closedBall ξ τ, G x ∂μ) / τ ^ (n + 1)) (Ioc σ ρ) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x ↦ u x * (q x / ‖x - ξ‖ ^ n)) (closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ σ) μ ∧ (∫ x in closedBall ξ ρ, u x ∂μ) / ρ ^ n - (∫ x in closedBall ξ σ, u x ∂μ) / σ ^ n = ∫ x in closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ σ, u x * (q x / ‖x - ξ‖ ^ n) ∂μ + ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, (∫ x in closedBall ξ τ, G x ∂μ) / τ ^ (n + 1)
